ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.8.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Psychology Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Psychology/wiki
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Requires RimSynapse - Core. Brings your colonists to life by giving them evolving memories, complex interpersonal trust, therapeutic sessions, and trauma responses.
--- Current Features --- - Dynamic Personality Traits: The nightly psychological evaluation tracks profound life events. Pawns can dynamically gain or lose RimWorld traits (such as gaining Bloodlust after a brutal raid, or losing Kind) based on LLM analysis of their rolling short-term memory. Cadence is adjustable in mod settings, from nightly up to every 7 days. - Trust and Familiarity System: Replaces vanilla's rigid opinion system with dynamic Trust (-100 to 100) and Familiarity (0 to 100) values. By default vanilla OpinionOf is scaled down by 50%, with the custom Trust metric contributing the remaining 50% weight - the blend is a slider. - Trauma, Despair and Mania: Three mental breaks vanilla does not have. A "Trauma Trigger" break has a pawn blindly firing at doors, walls or loud noises before cowering. A "Suicide/Self-Harm" break uses their equipped primary weapon against critical organs (5x damage by default, adjustable). And a pawn riding an extreme high - through bipolar, or a manic swing after a recent crash - can tip into "Euphoric (Reckless)" behaviour. - Therapy and Consoling: Right-click target pawns to initiate a Therapy Session. The therapist and patient will sit together and dynamically converse via the background LLM engine. Successful sessions have a dynamic chance (influenced by mood) to permanently cure/remove severe negative and psychological traits (including PTSD, Depressive, Pessimist, Volatile, Nervous, Psychopath, and Bloodlust - unless locked by their backstory). - Good Years Get Recorded: Good times are not just the absence of bad ones. A pawn who holds their mood at or above 85% for a sustained 24 in-game hours has the stretch picked up and queued for a psychological review, so it is written into their history alongside the hard years. - Ritual Remarks: Colonists pull from their LLM relationship memories to deliver personalized Vows during marriages and Eulogies during funerals. - Forced Psychological Reviews: Demand an immediate clinical evaluation of the pawn's mental state from the LLM via the new Social Network tab. - World VIP Backstories: Faction Leaders are no longer generic. They generate with a rich, ideologically consistent history and personality profile.
--- Planned Upcoming Features --- - Couples Counseling and Dynamic Romance: Breakups and romances driven entirely by shared memories and psychological compatibility rather than RNG. - LLM-Generated Phobias: Pawns who suffer specific traumas (e.g., severe burns, insectoid attacks) may develop targeted phobias that alter their pathing and combat behavior. - Group Therapy: Let your highest-social pawn lead group sessions to mass-resolve colony-wide trauma after devastating events. - Psychological Addictions: Pawns may turn to specific drugs as a coping mechanism for specific negative memories.
--- Roadmap --- 0.8.1 - Clinical Review Scheduling: the nightly psychological reviews plan themselves against the length of the night and finish by morning even on a large colony, instead of firing on a timer and running late. Plus close-out work on the living-traits engine. 0.9.0 - Prisoners, Leaders and Trait History: psychological profiles for prisoners, slaves and guests, so captives think and speak like themselves instead of sharing one blank register. Visitor and world-leader backstories can take in outside context and reflect where they came from. And a chronological trait-history timeline: every trait a colonist has gained or lost, dated, with the reasoning kept - including the losses, which are currently erased. 0.10.0 - Living Societies: colonists form cliques out of who they actually spend their time with, a rumour mill carries news between them, and crossing a friendship milestone sends you a letter. Therapy sessions gain the option to resolve in the background or be watched live as they play out. 0.11.0 - Social Network Visualization: the Social Network tab becomes a colony-wide graph of trust and familiarity - one node per colonist, edges coloured by the relationship, and cliques drawn out as groups. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.8.0) - Living Traits, Voice and Clinical Insight --- - NEW - Living traits: a colonist's personality now drifts from what they actually do and live through, weighed by an LLM judge and narrated back to you, with a feedback loop that learns as it goes. - NEW - Kindness and abrasiveness now register as social signals, feeding new affinity and devotion between colonists - and pawns pushed past their limits develop graduated aversions and their own ways of coping. - NEW - "Forming Traits" view: the pawn's Psychology window now shows which traits are drifting and where they are heading, with new sliders in mod settings to tune how fast personalities change. - NEW - Pawn Voice: Psychology now writes each colonist's narrative voice - their turn of phrase plus a spoken Kokoro voice - so they sound like themselves. - NEW - Colonists now form a memory of the day they arrived, and Psychology plugs into Core 0.8's shared context hooks so other modules can read a pawn's state. - Changed: the clinical evaluation is rebuilt into five dynamic sections with at-a-glance warning badges, and now covers only pawns affiliated with your colony. - Changed: episode narration only speaks up when a pawn was actually involved, uses the right pronouns, and runs as long as the moment deserves. - Performance: smoothed out the mental-break manager and trimmed hot-path costs for less stutter.
--- Changelog (v0.7.1) - Gradual personality and smarter memory --- - Fixed the headline bug: a colonist could gain Bloodlust and lose a steadfast trait just from repeatedly attacking an object (like a wrecked vehicle). Violence against inert objects is now clearly distinguished from harming the living and can no longer drive bloodthirsty personality changes. - NEW - Gradual, multi-day personality shifts: traits no longer flip in a single day. Evidence builds as "pressure" over several days, is resisted by steadfast traits (which also protect themselves from removal), and only fires once sustained - and an evaluation that calls a shift "unlikely" can no longer flip a trait at all. - NEW - Trait-change guardrails: only sanctioned traits can be added or removed (never, for example, Psychopath), at most one change per evaluation, with a cooldown between changes. - NEW - Mod settings sliders: trait-shift threshold and pressure decay, memory consolidation, abandonment risk, suicide damage, opinion/trust blend, and an evaluation cadence to cut LLM token cost. - Fixed: AI-driven mental breaks now actually fire (the request was previously left inert). - Fixed: therapy-session summaries are now kept as durable memories on both colonists instead of being discarded. - The daily evaluation now separates today from a lifetime of history, and the memory panel splits short vs long-term by real importance.
--- Changelog (v0.7.0) - Regions and Territories Compatibility --- - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Psychology/wiki/Changelog
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates memories of nobility and royal power. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates crises of faith and spiritual rebirth memories. Required for deep Faction Leader generation. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates genetic dysphoria and vat-grown trauma. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates void taint and cosmic horror PTSD. - RimSynapse - Factions: Compatible and Optional. Empowers world generation to build deep psychological profiles and traits for Faction Leaders. - RimSynapse - Chat: Compatible and Optional. Colonists' generated dialogue will be directly influenced by their current Trust levels, Familiarity, and accumulated traumas. - RimSynapse - WorldNews: Compatible and Optional. Prints gossip and news articles about your pawns' most dramatic psychological events and relationships.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
